stories_selected.title: Amazon Aurora MySQL 8.4.12 is now generally available
stories_selected.dba_relevance: Aurora MySQL 8.4.12 is now GA — teams running 8.4.x clusters should review the release notes for any fixes or behavioral changes and begin planning a minor-version upgrade.

stories_selected.title: Amazon Aurora Serverless for MySQL now supports up to 384 ACUs
stories_selected.dba_relevance: Aurora Serverless MySQL maximum capacity has increased to 384 ACUs, raising the ceiling for memory-intensive or high-concurrency serverless workloads — DBAs should revisit capacity configurations and cost estimates for clusters previously constrained by the prior limit.

stories_selected.title: Amazon RDS Custom now supports the latest Cumulative Update and GDR updates for Microsoft SQL Server
stories_selected.dba_relevance: RDS Custom for SQL Server now supports the latest CU and GDR patches — DBAs managing RDS Custom instances should check which updates are now available and assess whether security or stability patches warrant an immediate update cycle.

stories_selected.title: Announcing SQL Server 2025 Preview Support on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS
stories_selected.dba_relevance: SQL Server 2025 on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS is now available in preview starting with CU11 — this is explicitly not for production use, but DBAs standardizing Linux infrastructure on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS should begin compatibility and configuration validation now.
